title: Neon Tree God
description: A massive biomechanical tree entity with a menacing skull-like face dominates the center, featuring glowing green circuit eyes, sharp white teeth, and a CPU chip embedded in its forehead. Its dark branches reach into a starry sky while colorful raindrops and glowing embers fall between two dark rocky cliffs under a vibrant aurora-like sunset.
